description: Read customers, vendors, contacts, sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, bills, stock items, non-stock items and warehouses.

acumatica_new_bill_trigger.description: Runs for each new bill in Acumatica. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
